description: Maps CLI versions to compatible schema versions - append new entries on release

compatibility.notes: Same format and schema support as CLI 2.2.0. Compatibility output highlights installed support and the stable releases for legacy workflows.

Stable 0.9.0 is the default output and migration target; 0.8.0 remains supported as an input and explicit output. Modern processing accepts 0.8.0/0.9.0; native projection requires 0.9.0. Normalized YAML supports document, preserve and sorted ordering. JSON scalar recognition with string fallback replaces YAML Core resolution. 0.7.0 inputs and legacy conversion redirect to CLI 2.0.5 for migration to 0.8.0; CLI 1.2.4 handles historical 0.7.0 processing. Retired drafts and RCs require a matching historical CLI.

Stable 0.8.0 by default; opt into 0.9.0 RC.1. Modern processing accepts 0.8.0/0.9.0; native projection requires 0.9.0. Original stable and Draft 4 pins remain supported. Explicit selector > recognized schema > maintained format default. Historical 0.7.0 validation and chained migration remain supported; use CLI 1.2.4 for historical 0.7.0 processing.
Active processing targets Draft 4 only. Historical 0.7.0/0.8.0 validation and chained migration remain supported; use CLI 1.2.4/2.0.5 for historical processing.
Stable 0.8.0 CLI and recommended bridge for converting legacy capability dumps or MCP Description 0.7.0 to 0.8.0.
Emits and validates MCP Description 0.8.0; retains 0.7.0 validation and migration.
Emits MCP Description 0.8.0 RC.3; retains RC.2 processing and 0.7.0 validation and migration.
Emits MCP Description 0.8.0 RC.2; validates and migrates 0.7.0; no generated Cisco metadata.
Emits MCP Description 0.8.0 RC.1; validates and migrates 0.7.0; no generated Cisco metadata.
Recommended for processing historical MCP Description 0.7.0 without upgrading. Does not emit 0.8.0.
Initial open-source release. All prior internal versions are consolidated into this baseline.
